patches.head: 9d3aeb24cb864d5f99a7172e9004884bf3c1a9a0
patches.note: drm/apple: sRGB surfaces and an sRGB link colorimetry for external displays (unmerged upstream PR #157, 5 files, +73/-6). Rebased for wip5 (context only; previous sha256 9cd617e413c69006349e8ffa914ee0c16d1d7ba246d5afd9e1031aafbbf09573): the dcp-internal.h hunk now sits above the new dcp-panel-edid.h include and the plane.c hunk moved +194 lines after upstream's plane-layout rewrite. Added and removed lines are unchanged. Must be re-checked if #157 moves.

drm/apple: local, not upstream. A DCP whose DPTX RemotePort times out is passed over for 300 s, and a timed-out release no longer pins the port's DP tunnel route to it. Applies after 0001 to the #158 source (checked against the exact files; full-tree apply is checked by candidate.py prepare and CI). Never built or booted.

patches.head: 4da4932b130b21d7367d56859f558c4e8a8f101f
patches.note: drm/apple: dcp: let a Type-C port with HPD take over a pipeline held without it (omacom/linux-aurora PR #186 commit 1/3, author-reported on an M1 Pro J314s). Unmerged upstream; not reviewed upstream.

patches.head: bd1ad7b9b2795b7d3b3c7e616a54b78f9c92c6e0
patches.note: drm/apple: dcp: route a DP-alt port only once its sink asserts HPD (PR #186 commit 2/3). Its message reports that routing before HPD left the DPTX service on that DCP answering -110 until reboot, the symptom seen on dcpext1 (28cc00000) here.

patches.head: 2a37f6f206456462970b3bbb3bf9bf8bd8944acd
patches.note: usb: typec: tipd: treat -ENOSPC as a taken display on every SoC (PR #186 commit 3/3). Overlaps unmerged PR #163, which fixes the same bug by changing the cd321x_display_taken() signature; the two conflict, so only this one is carried.

qualification: Separate ConnectX Ethernet build candidate on wip5 source, no eGPU source changes. No native build, boot, adapter, network throughput, dock or recovery qualification.
